name: crispe-deep-paper-reading-plugin
description: Bilingual paper-reading suite: bounded research orchestration, full-paper analysis with worked examples and teaching functions, evidence-backed cross-paper links, and offline HTML reading slides. 双语论文精读套件：有界研究编排、保留原有阅读要素的单篇分析与教学函数、跨论文证据连接及离线 HTML 幻灯片。 Includes crispe-deep-paper-reading, crispe-paper-analyst, crispe-paper-cross-link, and crispe-slides-writer.
